newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE to meet resistance from 4,940.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE to meet resistance from 4,940.

text.p: The FTSE 100 will shrug off its cautious, indecisive state and go higher on Tuesday only to meet resistance at 4,940, technical analysts said.

With the market able to scamper above its 10-day moving average -- now at 4,880 -- on Monday, buying activity should outweigh that from selling as investors seem intent to continue the bull trend, they added.

In New York, the Dow too has had a similar tussle with its 10-day moving average -- now at 8,154 -- and it managed to close a little higher on Monday but this may be enough to also persuade buyers to push the Dow to a new high fairly soon.
By 0750 GMT, the FTSE was up 39.7 at 4,935.4 and on Monday, the Dow closed up 4.41 to 8,198.45.
